2. At this juncture, learned APP undertakes to produce chemical analysis report.
3. It is alleged that article namely sweet supari worth Rs. 2,880/- was seized from the shop owned by the applicant.

It is argued that procedure under Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 has not been followed.
Moreover, the question about applicability of notification and the provisions of Act are also canvassed.
In the circumstances, it is necessary to to go through the chemical analysis report.
Having regard to said facts, the applicant can be protected till the matter is heard.
